changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_inference_settings ( id SMALLINT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('local', 'cloud')), model TEXT CHECK (model IS NULL OR length(model) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), provider_id INTEGER, model_id INTEGER, provider_base_url TEXT, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), CHECK ( (mode = 'local' AND provider_id IS NULL AND model_id IS NULL AND provider_base_url IS NULL) OR (mode = 'cloud' AND model IS NOT NULL AND provider_id IS NOT NULL AND model_id IS NOT NULL AND provider_id > 0 AND model_id > 0 AND provider_base_url IS NOT NULL AND length(provider_base_url) > 0) ) );
ALTER TABLE agent_sessions ADD COLUMN inference_provider_id INTEGER, ADD COLUMN inference_model_id INTEGER, ADD COLUMN inference_base_url TEXT, ADD COLUMN inference_grant_hash TEXT UNIQUE, ADD COLUMN inference_client_tag TEXT, ADD CONSTRAINT agent_sessions_inference_pin CHECK ( (inference_provider_id IS NULL AND inference_model_id IS NULL AND inference_base_url IS NULL AND inference_grant_hash IS NULL AND inference_client_tag IS NULL) OR (inference_provider_id IS NOT NULL AND inference_model_id IS NOT NULL AND inference_provider_id > 0 AND inference_model_id > 0 AND model IS NOT NULL AND inference_base_url IS NOT NULL AND length(inference_base_url) > 0) ), ADD CONSTRAINT agent_sessions_inference_grant CHECK ( (inference_grant_hash IS NULL AND inference_client_tag IS NULL) OR (inference_grant_hash IS NOT NULL AND inference_grant_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') );
